notes.title: Update: 2020-05-31
notes.notes:
Minor graphic error fixes

 New language support: Japanese(日本語)

notes.title: Update: 2020-05-21
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where main character sometimes looked in the wrong direction when moving between rooms.

 Fixed animation issues that occurred when moving between rooms.

 Fixed an issue where players were able to interact with certain objects other than door and cabinet during the chase.

 Fixed an issue where the volume of sound effects played when acquiring some items was too loud.

 Miscellaneous minor bug fixes

notes.title: Update: 2020-05-10
notes.notes:
Adjusted some mistranslations where Audio Tapes were translated into Camcorder Tapes. (Applies to English version only)

 To prevent malfunction, now the puzzle [spoiler]that opens steel-barred door behind the drawer[/spoiler] will automatically reset every time you access it. However it won't be reset once you solve it.

notes.title: Update: 2020-05-09
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where some texts that appears during the first chase wasn't translated.

notes.title: Update: 2020-05-07
notes.notes:
Fixed an error with item icons and character graphics.

 Fixed an issue where players were able to interact with certain objects other than door and cabinet during the chase.

 Fixed an issue where pursuiter can be stuck in certain sections during the chase.

 Fixed an issue that caused some objects on the floor to block player movement.

 Fixed an issue where the sound effect when acquiring certain items was playing too loudly.

 [spoiler]Fixed an issue that caused the Grail on the floor to disappear in the ending scene.[/spoiler]

 Two hidden achievements were removed from the game.
